source.title: Export private key
source.purpose: Encrypt a private key with a password and create a complete document.

translation.title: 导出私钥
translation.purpose: 使用密码加密私钥并创建完整文档。

source.title: Export encrypted state
source.purpose: Serialize encrypted state without decrypting the private key.

translation.title: 导出已加密状态
translation.purpose: 序列化已经加密的状态，无需再次解密私钥。

source.title: Parse document
source.purpose: Read JSON text or bytes and validate the resulting document.

translation.title: 解析文档
translation.purpose: 读取 JSON 文本或字节并验证所得文档。

source.title: Validate document
source.purpose: Validate an in-memory value and return the normalized document.

translation.title: 验证文档
translation.purpose: 验证内存中的值并返回规范化文档。

source.title: Serialize document
source.purpose: Write a validated document as canonical JSON.

translation.title: 序列化文档
translation.purpose: 将已验证的文档写为规范 JSON。

source.title: Unlock document
source.purpose: Decrypt the private key and verify that it matches the document public key.

translation.title: 解锁文档
translation.purpose: 解密私钥并确认它与文档中的公钥匹配。

source.title: Read summary
source.purpose: Read format, version, label, and public-key metadata without secrets.

translation.title: 读取摘要
translation.purpose: 读取格式、版本、标签和公钥元数据，不暴露秘密。

source.title: Handle errors
source.purpose: Handle predictable failures through stable error codes.

translation.title: 处理错误
translation.purpose: 通过稳定错误码处理可预期的失败。
